## Context

`model_max_output_tokens` (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py`, `MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`) knows only the three Claude ladder models and falls back to `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS` (16,000) for an unmapped model. Amazon Nova models on Bedrock accept at most 10,000 output tokens, so every review call that rides the "raise to model max" seam with a Nova model is rejected by Bedrock with `ValidationException: The maximum tokens you requested exceeds the model limit of 10000` before it runs — measured live during the 2026-08-11 model-comparison experiments (rebar ticket b902-18af-14ed-4da1), where the whole plan-review LLM phase collapsed to INDETERMINATE until the table was patched in-process. Nova Pro subsequently completed 8/8 end-to-end plan-review replays, so the ceiling entry is the only blocker to running these models through rebar.

## Plan

Add four entries to `MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`: `("nova-pro", 10_000)`, `("nova-2-lite", 10_000)`, `("nova-lite", 10_000)`, `("nova-micro", 10_000)`. The lookup is a plain substring match, and `nova-lite` is NOT a substring of `nova-2-lite` (the `-2-` breaks it), so both forms are listed explicitly; the full Bedrock inference-profile ids (`us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0` etc.) are covered by the same substring semantics. Values per the AWS Bedrock model documentation: Nova family max output tokens = 10,000. No behavior change for any currently-configured model: the table is consulted only when the resolved model matches an entry, and the existing conservative fallback stays for everything else.

Extend the existing unit coverage of `model_max_output_tokens` with the Nova ids (full Bedrock profile-id form and bare form).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `model_max_output_tokens("bedrock:us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0")` returns 10000. Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from rebar.llm.review_kernel.verify import model_max_output_tokens as f; assert f('bedrock:us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0')==10000 and f('us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0')==10000 and f('claude-sonnet-4-6')==128000"` exits 0.
- [x] A unit test pins the Nova entries alongside the existing Claude entries. Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit/test_max_tokens_model_ceiling_1019.py -x` passes.
- [x] Unknown models still fall back to the configured default (existing behavior pinned by an assertion in the same test). Verify: same pytest run passes.
